items.headline: Flood Watch issued November 17 at 3:46PM PST until November 19 at 6:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Los Angeles County.

* WHEN...From Thursday morning through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive rainfall may result in significant flooding of
roads and other low-lying areas, heavy flows in creeks and canyons,
rockslides, mudslides, and debris flows in recent burn scars.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Rain rates up to 1 inch per hour are expected, especially in the
mountains.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 17 at 2:15PM PST until November 17 at 9:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 4 to 7 feet. Dangerous rip
currents expected.

* WHERE...Malibu Coast and Los Angeles County Beaches.

* WHEN...Until 9 PM PST this evening.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk for ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Large
breaking waves can cause injury, wash people off beaches and
rocks, and capsize small boats near shore. Minor tidal
overflow during morning high tides.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A High Surf Advisory will likely be issued
for Thursday.
items.instruction:
Remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions, or stay
near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly in
such conditions, stay off the rocks.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 17 at 1:30PM PST until November 18 at 3:00AM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Hazardous sea conditions.

* WHERE...East Santa Barbara Channel from Pt. Conception to Pt.
Mugu CA including Santa Cruz Island and Inner waters from
Point Mugu to San Mateo Pt. CA including Santa Catalina and
Anacapa Islands.

* WHEN...Until 3 AM PST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...See the Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFLOX)
for more.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
